evals.name: runtime-bindings
evals.prompt: We deploy the booking gateway to production and temporary review deployments. Reviews keep reading the wrong directory even though operators supply their connection settings, and changing the environment map after startup changes request behavior. Fix the deployment setup so a new deployment can follow the README contract without adding source changes or profile files. Preserve the public APIs and GET /slots behavior, add regression coverage, document a safe operator example, and run scala-cli test . --server=false.
evals.expected_output: A gateway using independent validated runtime settings and stable component configuration, with actual HTTP resource bindings replaceable across deployments and preserved request/failure behavior.
expectations: III: Independent runtime settings have the same meaning for every deployment label.
III: Missing and unusable required settings fail with the setting name.
III: Supplied optional settings are validated rather than silently defaulted.
III: Invalid deployment settings terminate the real entrypoint before it serves work.
III: Started components consume their validated settings without rereading the environment.
IV: The same compiled service uses replacement endpoint paths, queries, and credentials in fresh processes.
IV: Directory failures remain failures without exposing credentials or upstream payloads.
III: Invalid bindings and credentials produce useful credential-safe errors.
